note: Synthetic test samples written for checking Jev question wording. Not real news. Never display these as evidence. The evidence objects follow the proposed shape in docs/api-contract-v0.md (branch jet/a1-api-contract). 'expected' is a hand-written first-pass answer key; direction and materiality are null when the item is not about the company. Materiality: 0 = routine or promotional, 1 = notable, 2 = major.

evidence.title: Apple reports record quarterly revenue on strong iPhone demand
evidence.summary: Apple said quarterly revenue rose to a record, helped by stronger than expected iPhone sales, and raised its outlook for the next quarter.

evidence.title: Apple recalls a batch of laptop chargers over overheating reports
evidence.summary: Apple is recalling a limited batch of chargers sold in two countries after a small number of overheating reports. No injuries were reported.

evidence.title: Apple to open a new retail store in Austin next month
evidence.summary: Apple will open one new retail store next month, bringing its total in the state to nineteen.

evidence.title: Regulators fine Apple over app store rules; company to appeal
evidence.summary: A regulator imposed a multibillion-dollar fine on Apple over its app store payment rules and ordered changes to the business. Apple said it will appeal.

evidence.title: Ten gadgets we loved this year
evidence.summary: A roundup of consumer gadgets including a smart speaker, a camera drone and a pair of headphones. An Apple watch band is mentioned among the accessories.

evidence.title: Apple posts higher services revenue but warns of weaker hardware sales
evidence.summary: Apple reported strong growth in services revenue for the quarter, while warning that hardware sales are expected to decline next quarter.

evidence.title: Nvidia raises full-year forecast as data center orders surge
evidence.summary: Nvidia raised its full-year revenue forecast, citing a sharp increase in orders for its data center chips.

evidence.title: Nvidia says new export limits will cut sales to a key market
evidence.summary: Nvidia said newly announced export restrictions will significantly reduce its sales to one of its largest markets in the coming quarters.

evidence.title: Nvidia names new head of investor relations
evidence.summary: Nvidia appointed a new head of investor relations, replacing an executive who is retiring.

evidence.title: Rival chipmaker unveils processor it says beats competitors
evidence.summary: A competing chipmaker announced a new processor and described its design and launch schedule in detail. It claimed the chip outperforms products from Nvidia and others.

evidence.title: Nvidia signs deal to supply driver-assistance chips to an automaker
evidence.summary: Nvidia announced a multi-year agreement to supply driver-assistance chips to a mid-sized automaker.

evidence.title: Nvidia delays next-generation chip by a quarter but says demand remains strong
evidence.summary: Nvidia said its next-generation chip will ship one quarter later than planned because of a packaging issue, and added that customer orders remain ahead of supply.

evidence.title: Tesla quarterly deliveries fall well short of analyst expectations
evidence.summary: Tesla delivered far fewer vehicles in the quarter than analysts expected, its largest shortfall in several years.

evidence.title: Tesla wins approval to build a new battery plant
evidence.summary: Tesla received regulatory approval to build a battery plant that it says will expand its production capacity.

evidence.title: Tesla recalls vehicles to fix a software issue with an over-the-air update
evidence.summary: Tesla is recalling a group of vehicles to correct a warning-light software issue. The fix will be delivered by an over-the-air update.

evidence.title: Tesla launches referral promotion offering free charging credits
evidence.summary: Tesla started a limited-time referral promotion that gives new buyers free charging credits.

evidence.title: City council approves new downtown parking rules
evidence.summary: A city council approved new parking rules for its downtown area. A council member noted that electric vehicles such as Teslas will be subject to the same rules.

evidence.title: Tesla reports higher revenue while profit margin narrows
evidence.summary: Tesla reported higher quarterly revenue than a year earlier, while its profit margin fell to its lowest level in three years.

evidence.title: Electric vehicle registrations rise across Europe
evidence.summary: Industry data showed electric vehicle registrations rose across Europe last month. Several manufacturers, including Tesla, were listed among those with gains.
